overview: This batch focuses on finalizing the endgame state machine and optimizing memory footprint for long-running simulations. By implementing deterministic state hashing and a compact tick-based history buffer, we ensure 100% reproducibility and minimal memory overhead for the 5,500+ tick campaign. These changes close the final gaps in simulation determinism and resource management.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic State Hashing for Endgame Snapshots
tasks.architectural_spec: Create a zero-heap, constexpr-friendly hash function for the core simulation state. Use a 64-bit FNV-1a variant. The struct `EndgameSnapshot` will hold the tick count, active colonist IDs (fixed array), and resource totals. The hash is computed incrementally per tick to avoid full re-scans. No dynamic allocations. All logic fits within 40 lines.
acceptance_criteria: Hash value is identical across 100 Monte Carlo runs for the same seed.
No heap allocations during hash computation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save/load consistency and enables fast, reliable replay verification.

tasks.title: Compact Tick-Based History Buffer for Colonist Paths
tasks.architectural_spec: Replace the std::deque path history with a circular buffer of fixed size (e.g., 64 entries). Each entry stores a packed 32-bit coordinate and a 16-bit timestamp. Use `std::array` for storage. Implement `push_back` and `get_at_offset` with O(1) complexity. Total logic under 50 lines. No virtual functions.
acceptance_criteria: Memory usage per colonist reduced by 40%.
Path reconstruction is accurate for the last 64 ticks.
No cache misses in tight simulation loops.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother frame rates during large-scale colony views due to reduced cache pressure.

tasks.title: Static Event Queue for Endgame Ascension Triggers
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a static array of `Event` structs for the final 10 ticks. Each event contains a tick ID and a string ID (enum). Implement a simple linear search for the current tick. No dynamic memory. Logic is purely declarative and fits in 30 lines. Integrates with the existing `StateHash` system.
acceptance_criteria: Events trigger exactly at their defined tick.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Provides clear, immediate feedback on ascension milestones without lag.
